locale_code.description: Not translated: the language code of this catalog (BCP 47), for the lang attribute.

locale_dir.description: Not translated: the writing direction of this catalog, ltr or rtl.

extension_name.description: The brand. Keep it in Latin letters in every language.

extension_description.message: Removes most of the background music from YouTube™ videos and keeps the voices. Everything runs on your computer.
extension_description.description: Store summary and extensions-page description. 132 characters at most.

control_name.description: Name and tooltip of the player button while the music plays; a click removes it. Like YouTube's "Mute", it says what a click does.

control_on.description: Name and tooltip of the player button while nomusic removes the music; a click brings the music back. Like YouTube's "Unmute", it says what a click does, with the same verb as "Remove music".

control_setup.description: Tooltip and name of the player button before the first run; it opens the page that turns nomusic on.

control_failed.description: Tooltip of the player button after a failure; it reopens the choice.

notice_working.description: Under a spinner in the middle of the video while it waits a moment for the first audio without music (at the start, or after a jump).

notice_blocked.description: Name, read by screen readers, of the round play button in the middle of the video when the browser needs a click before it plays sound.

panel_title.description: Title of the failure dialog; the reason follows it.

panel_original.description: Plays the video with its original audio, music included. Must be unmistakable.

failure_protected.description: Copy-protected: the owner locked the video, as rented movies are.

failure_codec.message: This video’s sound format isn’t supported.

failure_uncaptured.message: Reloading the page usually fixes this.
failure_uncaptured.description: Also shown on a video that was already playing when the user turned nomusic on: a reload is all it needs.

failure_source.message: This player’s sound can’t be reached.

failure_slow.message: It’s taking too long. Your computer may be busy.

failure_engine.message: Reloading the page usually fixes this.

failure_audio.message: The sound didn’t start. Reloading the page usually fixes this.

failure_updated.message: nomusic was updated or turned off. Reload the page to continue.

setup_heading.description: Heading of the first-run page: what the user gets.

consent_text.message: To remove most of the music, nomusic reads the sound of the YouTube videos you play, on this computer only. It never uploads or saves the sound. Chrome may sync your settings.
consent_text.description: The disclosure before nomusic reads any audio (first-run page, and the popup's one row before the first run); the privacy policy link follows it. Keep every fact: reads the videos' sound, on this computer only, never uploaded or saved, settings may sync (through Chrome Sync). "Most of the music" keeps the heading honest.

consent_accept.description: The one button of the disclosure: the user's consent.

done_text.message: If a YouTube tab was already open, reload it.
done_text.description: nomusic cannot reach tabs opened before it was turned on; most users have none, so the condition comes first. On the first-run page, and under the popup's switch right after it is turned on there.

done_open.description: Button: opens youtube.com in this tab.

popup_autostart_label.description: The one switch in the toolbar popup. Before the first run, turning it on is the consent, with the disclosure under it.

link_help.description: Link to the project's issue tracker.
